question: 设 $\Sigma: x^2+y^2+z^2=1$，取外侧，$f(u)$ 是连续函数，则  $$\iint_{\Sigma} [f(x^2\sin(x^4y))+2] dy dz + [f(x\arctan(y^2z))+2y] dz dx + z^2 dx dy = \underline{\qquad\qquad}$$
raw_question_text: 设 $\Sigma: x^2+y^2+z^2=1$，取外侧，$f(u)$ 是连续函数，则  $$\iint_{\Sigma} [f(x^2\sin(x^4y))+2] dy dz + [f(x\arctan(y^2z))+2y] dz dx + z^2 dx dy = \underline{\qquad\qquad}$$
